segments.segment_summary: A man in a workshop shows two bags of seed, explains their purpose, and then prepares to leave the workshop on a tractor to plant them in a field.

key_moments.caption: A man shows two large white bags of Agassiz seed and points to the one for the wetland area.
The man, wearing a baseball cap, talks to the camera in his workshop, explaining he is ready to go.
A point-of-view shot from a tractor driving along a tilled path next to a cornfield.

segments.segment_summary: In a field, a man cuts open a bag of seeds with a knife, shows a handful of the seeds to the camera, and then pours the contents of the bag into a red seed spreader attached to a tractor.

key_moments.caption: A man uses a knife to cut open the top of a white seed bag.
He holds a handful of the fluffy seeds up to the camera.
The seeds are poured from the white bag into a red seed spreader.

segments.segment_summary: Standing by his tractor in a field, a man explains to the camera that he is not sure how to set the seed spreader and will be guessing based on the spreading chart. He then adjusts a lever on the machine before getting ready to start.

key_moments.caption: A man talks to the camera, explaining he's not sure what he's doing and pointing to the spreading chart on the machine.
He explains his plan to start with a light setting to avoid running out of seed too early.
A close-up shot shows the man adjusting a lever on the red seed spreader.
The man mounts his camera on the tractor, preparing to drive.
